title: How Indiahikes Manages Waste Generated On Trails
description:
At Indiahikes, we collect a lot of waste from the trails. In 2018 alone, we collected more than 22 tonnes of waste from the Himalayas. But there's no use collecting this waste if we don't manage it well. 

Our Green Trails team has put together a process to segregate ALL the waste that is collected from trails, villages and dhabas. 

Watch the video to learn about how we manage waste. A big shout out to all our trekkers who help us collect this waste from the trails!
